translation_notes: g.value(subject, RDFS.label) -> m{ {subject} rdfs:label ?o }(g).first(): the trav_single_value idiom, a one-line, one-construction gain.

fixture.ttl: a subject with two rdfs:label values (both sides pick the same one, since both parse the identical file into the same default in-memory store), a subject with no label at all (zero-solution -> falls back to the URI fragment), and a neighbouring subject with its own label that must not match.
_label_for(g, subject, uri_str) takes three arguments, not just a graph, so driver.py builds the calls by hand instead of the generic fixture= wiring.
